exams.name: National Police Officer Selection Test
exams.blurb: A widely used written police entrance exam from Stanard & Associates assessing math, reading, writing and situational judgment.

exams.name: Nelson-Denny Reading Test
exams.blurb: A standardized reading comprehension and vocabulary test frequently used during public safety hiring and promotion processes.

exams.name: NYPD Police Officer Exam
exams.blurb: The open-competitive written exam for appointment as a New York City police officer covering reading, reasoning and situational judgment.

exams.name: POST Entry-Level Law Enforcement Test Battery
exams.blurb: California’s standardized written peace-officer exam measuring reading comprehension, writing and reasoning for law enforcement eligibility.

exams.name: Sheriff’s Deputy Entrance Exam
exams.blurb: A county-level written and physical exam for deputy sheriff candidates assessing judgment, reading and law enforcement aptitude.

exams.name: State Trooper Entrance Exam
exams.blurb: The written entrance exam used by state police and highway patrol agencies covering reading, reasoning and situational awareness.

exams.name: Texas Commission on Law Enforcement Exam
exams.blurb: Texas’s licensing exam for peace officers completing the basic academy and covering state law, traffic and use-of-force knowledge.

exams.name: APCO Public Safety Telecommunicator 1
exams.blurb: The APCO standard for training and certifying entry-level 911 telecommunicators in call handling, protocols and stress management.

exams.name: CritiCall Dispatcher Test
exams.blurb: A computer-based 911 dispatcher exam measuring multitasking, data entry, memory, map reading and call-summary writing skills.

exams.name: Emergency Number Professional
exams.blurb: A certification for 911 center managers covering telecommunications technology, policy and the operation of public safety answering points.

exams.name: Certified Jail Officer
exams.blurb: A credential for jail officers covering detention standards, inmate management and facility safety best practices.

exams.name: Corrections Officer Entrance Exam
exams.blurb: A written and physical exam for correctional officer candidates assessing judgment, reading, situational awareness and fitness.

exams.name: Juvenile Detention Officer Exam
exams.blurb: A written and fitness exam for staff supervising youth in juvenile detention covering behavior management and safety.

exams.name: Probation and Parole Officer Exam
exams.blurb: A written exam for community supervision officers assessing judgment, writing, casework reasoning and legal knowledge.

exams.name: Antiterrorism Officer Certification
exams.blurb: The DoD antiterrorism training and certification for officers who plan and coordinate force protection measures against terrorist threats.

exams.name: Aviation Selection Test Battery
exams.blurb: A selection battery for Navy and Marine aviation candidates measuring math, aviation and nautical aptitude for flight training.

exams.name: Construction Health and Safety Technician
exams.blurb: A BCSP credential for technicians who support safety and health programs on construction projects and job sites.

exams.name: DoD SkillBridge Program
exams.blurb: A DoD transition program letting service members train and earn civilian credentials with employers before leaving the military.

exams.name: OPSEC Professional Certification
exams.blurb: A DoD certification for practitioners who identify critical information and apply operations security countermeasures to protect it.
